pages.text: $(l)Comb rolls.$() Most bees bring home their comb every trip. A few also bring home a rarer second comb now and then, and two bees roll for their own comb. Odds and rates: $(l:basics/rare_combs)Rare Combs$(/l).

$(l)Home dimension.$() Nether bees work at half speed outside the Nether, the ender bee outside the End, and every other bee outside the Overworld.$(br2)$(l)Home biome.$() Most biome bees spend 20% less time in a hive in their home biome. The royal queen gives the same boost; they don't stack.
$(l)Day and weather.$() Overworld bees work in daytime and dry weather. Starlight bees work only at night. In the Nether and the End bees work all the time.
